data.gender_notes: Ewen is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Welsh mythology, Ewen was the name of the god of youth and the protector of young warriors. The name derives from the Old Welsh eugen, meaning 'born of a yew tree'. The name Ewen carries the meaning “Youth, young warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ewen usually hope their child will grow to embody youth, young warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the youthful spirit, courage, and protection.
data.etymology: Ewen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youth, young warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ewen total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ewen has Celtic roots and holds an important place in the history of Welsh mythology. Ewen was believed to be the god of youth and the protector of young warriors. In Scottish Gaelic tradition, it was the name given to the god of the hunt. While its usage has declined outside of these communities, it holds a rich cultural significance and connection to the past.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ewen has spiritual significance in representing youth, protection, and a connection to nature. In Welsh mythology, it signified the power and strength of the god of youth, embodying the idea of growth, vitality, and rebirth. As the protector of young warriors, Ewen conveyed a sense of valor and strength, as well as a reminder of the importance of youth and its potential for growth. Additionally, in Scottish Gaelic tradition, the name's association with the god of the hunt emphasizes the spiritual connection to nature and the natural world. Ultimately, the name Ewen embodies the idea of renewal, resilience, and the power of youth.
